visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a blurred background of a wooden shelf and a large, pink-accented text box. (2) The scene transitions to the 'Aiam' retail store, featuring light-colored wooden walls and a woman in a grey vest and face mask browsing the counter. Perfume bottles are displayed under glass domes on tiered white pedestals. (3) The perspective shifts to 'MUCHA,' where the store interior has a vintage, artistic style with ornate shelves. Close-up shots highlight perfume bottles with Art Nouveau-style labels featuring female illustrations. (4) We see the 'ROAliv' store section, showcasing a modern wooden display with glass sample holders. A hand with blue nail polish is shown holding a scent test strip and then a clear, oval-shaped perfume bottle. (5) The final phase shows a branded display shelf for 'ROAliv' followed by a graphic outro on a pink background containing a QR code and social media icons.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Slogan]: 日本小眾香水 3選. [Variety]: 回頭率超高仙女香. (2) [Slogan]: / Aiam /. [Variety]: 這家都是花香調和果香調 超級適合約會唷! (很有女人味). (3) [Slogan]: 味道幾乎無雷 每款都各具有特色. 最推薦 chapter 65 (人氣香). (4) [Slogan]: 除了香水之外 還有身體保養、擴香等產品. 櫃位還蠻多的 到日本玩千萬不要錯過. (5) [Slogan]: / MUCHA /. [Variety]: 以藝術家慕夏的作品 作為靈感發想. 包裝美翻了 根本可以當作收藏品. (6) [Slogan]: 我第一次逛 就整個被迷住. 最有人氣的是這罐 LILY. (7) [Slogan]: 是很優雅的味道 日常就能噴. MUCHA 多為花香調 送人自用都很推! (8) [Slogan]: / ROAliv /. [Variety]: 這個品牌的調香相當特別 聞過一次就忘不了! (9) [Slogan]: 我最愛 ninetieth. 它是帶有皮革味的木質香 調香非常高級 超適合秋冬!!! (10) [Slogan]: 喜歡清新香味的話 可以試試 black tea 和 clear. 一罐不用台幣 1,000 CP值很高!!! (11) [Slogan]: 快傳給身邊的香水控! 香水控本人記得先收藏起來. (12) [Slogan]: 掃描上方 QR code 領取「日本百貨優惠券總整理」. 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結 japanuts.com.
